title: Wesbrook Park
description: 1 playground in Wesbrook Park (Wesbrook Village, UBC), with an outdoor fitness corner (KOMPAN) and a bouldering wall at its south side. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken. The tube slide tower is by Corocord (2019, ages 5-12). Also has a post with three red rings whose use is unknown.
location: Wesbrook Village, University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC
source: Own survey
rights: CC BY 4.0
image_alt_text: The tube slide tower as a whole, from the front.
description_ja: Wesbrook Park（UBC の Wesbrook Village）にある遊び場 1 か所。南側に屋外の運動器具の一角（KOMPAN 社）と登り壁がある。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。すべり台の塔は Corocord 社製（2019 年、5〜12 歳向け）。赤い輪が 3 つ付いた、用途の分からない柱もある。
